dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: Q3 2026 organic revenue growth guided at around +5% despite persistent macroeconomic and geopolitical tensions; the FIFA World Cup incremental effect recedes (60% of the >EUR 30m total already captured in Q2 vs 40% expected in Q3, versus a 50/50 split initially communicated at the Q1 call).
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: No formal quantified full-year revenue/margin guidance (group convention: quarterly-only guider). Full-year net capex confirmed at ~8% of revenue despite a lower H1 (5.9%), as new-contract rollouts were delayed into H2 (higher inventory, incl. Carmila). Management explicitly cautious on H2 margins: the start-up phase of new contracts is dilutive and the sports tailwind recedes - H2 margin progression will not match the H1 pace.
pointsCles: Record H1 revenue of EUR 1,953.9m, +4.6% reported / +5.7% organic (Q1 and Q2 both +5.7%), with Q2 far above the ~+3% guidance despite the Middle-East conflict - driven by digital (42.8% of group revenue, +14.5% organic; programmatic +30.9% to 12.3% of digital revenue) and a FIFA World Cup effect above initial expectations (>EUR 30m incremental, 60% captured in Q2 / 40% expected in Q3, vs 50/50 initially flagged).

Spectacular operating leverage: operating margin +16.8% to EUR 359m (18.4% rate, +190bp), recurring EBIT +53.5% to EUR 136.2m (7.0% margin, +220bp) on rents & fees up only +3.4% and other opex +0.9%; published group net income of EUR 140.1m (+84.7%) is inflated by a non-taxable EUR 47.5m APG|SGA disposal gain - underlying net growth of +23.3% (CFO-confirmed) is the basis retained for the Omnium base.

H1 free cash flow turned positive at EUR 26.2m (+EUR 91.1m YoY) despite the usually adverse first-half seasonality, with cash flow before working capital nearly tripling to >EUR 100m; net debt down EUR 284.1m YoY (>EUR 200m excluding the EUR 79m APG|SGA proceeds), EUR 1.28bn cash plus an undrawn EUR 825m RCF, and both rating agencies lifted their outlook from stable to positive.

Portfolio quality confirmed: Heathrow renewed for 8 years WITHOUT a tender at broadly unchanged terms (154 airports, 14 of the world's 25 largest; Denver starting ~6 months late), VIOOH now cash-on-cash breakeven standalone and EBIT-positive at group level; management explicitly cautious on H2 - new contracts (Barcelona, Stockholm, Carmila) in dilutive start-up phase and a receding sports tailwind - with Q3 guided at ~+5% organic and full-year net capex kept at ~8% of revenue.

hypothese.summary: H1 2026 tres nettement au-dessus des attentes (CA organique +5,7% contre une guidance T2 de ~+3%), porte par le digital/programmatique et un effet Coupe du Monde FIFA superieur aux attentes initiales, avec un levier operationnel spectaculaire (EBIT recurrent H1 +53,5%). Element important a isoler : la cession finalisee de la participation residuelle APG|SGA a genere une plus-value non taxable de 47,5 M EUR au H1, deja anticipee comme optionnalite a la creation mais desormais realisee et explicitement exclue de la base Omnium (croissance nette ex-cet element : +23,3%, toujours tres solide). omniumEPS 2026 releve de 1,30 a 1,49 EUR.
hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
World #1 in out-of-home advertising, the only global player in a fragmented market. H1 2026 amplified the setup thesis: organic +5.7% (vs ~+3% guided for Q2), with the Middle-East conflict better absorbed than feared and a FIFA World Cup effect above expectations (+30M incremental). Operating leverage showed spectacularly: recurring EBIT +53.5%, margin +190bp. Published net (+84.7%) is inflated by a non-taxable APG|SGA disposal gain (47.5M) excluded from the Omnium base.

== THESIS READ ==
- Operating leverage is the thesis and it is now demonstrated at scale; digital/programmatic mix keeps rising. Watch: Q3 print vs the ~+5% guided.
- H2 deliberately modeled BELOW the H1 run-rate: management explicit on dilutive start-up phase of new contracts and receding sports tailwind. Watch: start-up contract margins.
- Middle-East exposure (~5% of revenue) absorbed better than feared. Watch: Dubai/UAE airport traffic.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Quarterly-only guider: no formal annual guidance exists, so the annual scorecard function is unmeasurable by design (documented). Base = recurring published (quasi-recurrents kept), APG|SGA one-off excluded. Bridge 'other' nets associates against minorities - approximation to refine with full statements.

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
FY26 build-up: H1 actual (1,953.9M) + H2 on the Q3 guidance (~+5% organic, moderated) -> ~4,160M. EBIT ~480M (H1 rhythm moderated per management warnings). Net 317M / EPS 1.49 on the CFO's normalized +23.3% net growth (ex-APG). Bridge: ETR 28%, finNet declining with deleveraging (587 -> 110M). Shares ~flat. Watch: consensus cross-check (snapshot only); associates/minorities split.

== CATALYSTS ==
Q3 revenue (Nov); new-contract ramp margins; Middle-East normalization; programmatic/digital share gains.

ancrages.moteur: CA H1 26 +5,7% organique (T1 et T2 tous deux a +5,7%), tres au-dessus de la guidance T2 donnee au call FY25/T1 26 (~+3%) - la resilience du modele face au conflit Moyen-Orient (mieux absorbe que redoute selon le management) et l'effet Coupe du Monde FIFA (+30 M EUR incrementaux, superieurs aux attentes initiales) expliquent l'essentiel de ce beat. Reconstruction bottom-up retenue : H1 reel (1 953,9 M EUR) + H2 estime par application de la guidance T3 (~+5% organique) au comparant H2 2025, donnant un FY2026 CA ~4 160 M EUR (vs 4 030 M EUR a la creation, +3,2%).

Plus-value de 47,5 M EUR liee a la cession finalisee du solde de la participation APG|SGA (10,85%, accord NZZ) comptabilisee au H1 26, non taxable comme anticipe a la creation - traitee comme un vrai one-off, exclue integralement de la base Omnium (deja la methodologie retenue a la creation : 'connue mais non projetee'). Le CFO confirme explicitement une croissance du resultat net de +23,3% hors cet element, chiffre retenu comme base de la reconstruction du resultat net normalise H1.

EBIT recurrent H1 26 +53,5% (marge +220pb a 7%), operating margin H1 +16,8% (marge +190pb a 18,4%) - effet de ciseaux tres favorable (loyers/redevances +3,4% seulement vs CA +4,6%, autres couts operationnels +0,9% seulement) nettement superieur a l'hypothese de creation. Le management previent neanmoins explicitement d'un ralentissement du rythme de progression de marge au S2 du fait du demarrage de nouveaux contrats (dilutif en phase de lancement) et de l'attenuation du tailwind Coupe du Monde - trajectoire de marge 2026-2030 revisee a la hausse mais de facon moins prononcee que le seul H1 ne le suggererait.

Renouvellement du contrat Heathrow pour 8 ans sans appel d'offres, conditions tarifaires globalement inchangees vs les 10 dernieres annees - confirmation de la resilience du portefeuille aeroportuaire (154 aeroports, 14 des 25 plus grands mondiaux), sans impact chiffrable materiel isole (deja dans la base contractuelle existante). [Confiance haute sur l'occurrence, sans impact chiffrable isole.]

FCF H1 26 devenu positif (26,2 M EUR, amelioration de 91,1 M EUR sur un an) malgre la saisonnalite habituellement defavorable du premier semestre - trajectoire de desendettement 2026-2030 revisee legerement a la hausse (dette nette FY2026 estimee legerement inferieure a l'hypothese de creation).

Programmatique +30,9% organique au H1 (12,3% du CA digital, contre 10,1% un an plus tot), VIOOH desormais breakeven cash-on-cash en standalone et deja rentable en EBIT au niveau groupe - confirme et amplifie l'ancrage de croissance digitale deja retenu a la creation.
